title: רב איתי
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Rav Ittai spoke to Rav Assi. Rav Ittai said in Rav’s name. Issi was in Rav Ashi’s time; thus there are two. Later, at the end of the letter alef, Yuchasin writes Rav Ittai said in Rav’s name; another version: Rav Ittai before Rav, Pesulei Hammukdashin. I have seen neither, only Jerusalem Talmud, Bikkurim, chapter 2: Rabbi Yochanan said, “Did not Rabbi Ittai teach us thus?”
